title: An Index Theorem for Fredholm Operators via the Unitary Conjugation Groupoid
summary: In a previous paper we introduced the unitary conjugation groupoid associated to any unital separable Type I C*-algebra. This groupoid encodes the representation-theoretic structure of the algebra through the action of its unitary group on the characters of commutative subalgebras and admits a canonical embedding of the algebra into its groupoid C*-algebra. In this paper we apply this framework to two fundamental operator algebras: the algebra of all bounded operators on a separable Hilbert space and the unitization of the compact operators.
